scope_notes: Registry CHOL spans intrahepatic (ICD-10 C22.1, tabulated under liver) and perihilar/distal extrahepatic (ICD-10 C24, tabulated under gallbladder_biliary) cholangiocarcinoma; GDC primary_site for the 36-sample TCGA-CHOL expression cohort is 32 Liver and intrahepatic bile ducts and 4 Other and unspecified parts of biliary tract. Do not sum liver and gallbladder_biliary burden shares twice.

Pan-biliary source-scope grouping spanning gallbladder carcinoma (GBC, gallbladder_biliary) plus intrahepatic (liver) and extrahepatic (gallbladder_biliary) cholangiocarcinoma (CHOL). Do not sum liver and gallbladder_biliary burden shares twice.

Salivary gland carcinomas (ICD-10 C07-C08) are explicitly included in head_and_neck incidence and mortality (GLOBOCAN 2024 Salivary glands: 55,229 world cases and 20,707 world deaths; US SEER/ACS Oral cavity & pharynx C00-C14 includes C07-C08).

Thymic epithelial tumors (ICD-10 C37) lack a standalone ACS/GLOBOCAN row and fall outside head_and_neck ICD-10 C00-C14/C32; mapped to head_and_neck only as a thoracic/anterior-mediastinal grouping fallback.
NUT carcinoma arises across thoracic/pulmonary and head-and-neck midline sites and has no standalone ICD-10 burden row.
